conditions: Both functions differentiable at the point; denominator v nonzero; common differentiation variable.
spoken_aliases: the derivative of the quotient of u divided by v equals the fraction with numerator u prime times v minus u times v prime and denominator v squared

evidence: Write the quotient difference over v(x+h)v(x). Its numerator is v(x)(u(x+h)-u(x))-u(x)(v(x+h)-v(x)). Divide by h and take the limit using continuity and v(x) nonzero; the result is (u'v-uv')/v^2.
